parameters.formDescription: Descrivi il pezzo che ti serve: ti rispondiamo entro 48 ore.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', temperature: 0, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You extract data from a request for quotation (RFQ) sent to Brixia Steel Components, a sheet metal fabricator. Return ONLY a JSON object with these keys: tipo_pezzo, quantita, materiale, spessore, finitura, formato_disegno, scadenza, campi_mancanti, riepilogo, bozza_risposta. Use null for any value not stated. A complete RFQ needs four items: quantita, materiale, formato_disegno, scadenza. campi_mancanti is an array with the Italian names of the missing required items, chosen from: quantita, materiale, formato del disegno, scadenza di consegna. Use an empty array if nothing is missing. Accepted drawing formats: DWG, DXF, STEP (PDF is accepted but slows quoting). riepilogo: one Italian sentence summarizing the request. bozza_risposta: a short, polite reply email in Italian, signed Ufficio Commerciale Brixia Steel Components. If items are missing, ask only for those. If complete, confirm that a quote will follow within 48 hours. Never invent data.' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Azienda: ' + $json['Azienda'] + '\nRichiesta: ' + $json['Descrizione della richiesta'] } ] }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ inputs: [ { idProperty: 'email', id: $json.email, properties: { email: $json.email, firstname: $json.nome, lastname: $json.cognome, company: $json.azienda } } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: { hs_timestamp: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString(), hs_task_subject: 'RFQ incompleta - ' + $('Prepara Dati').first().json.azienda + ': chiedere ' + $('Prepara Dati').first().json.campi_mancanti.join(', '), hs_task_body: $('Prepara Dati').first().json.bozza_risposta, hs_task_status: 'NOT_STARTED', hs_task_priority: 'HIGH', hs_task_type: 'EMAIL' }, associations: [ { to: { id: $json.results[0].id }, types: [ { associationCategory: 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', associationTypeId: 204 } ] } ] }) }}
